scope: Table 232 /MaxLen as used by scripted CharLimit changes and subsequent field text writes; this is a bounded model/API consistency review, not a whole §12.7 certification.

source.table_entry: MaxLen: integer; optional and inheritable; maximum length of the field's text, in characters.
source.ec3_review: The table is on physical 556 / printed 541; #191's primary StrikeOut/Caret group on that page inserts 'An integer value greater than or equal to zero that is the' into the /MaxLen description. This is a producer-validity qualification. It does not create a reader duty to reject negative values. The valid draft fixtures use positive limits.

owner_decisions.decision: Cut programmatic text values from set_field, scripts and imports to /MaxLen in pdf-model.
Apply the model's cut to values entering its edit log, including script writes, against an inherited text-field /MaxLen.
A script's charLimit maps to Table 232 /MaxLen and the property is saved on the field.

effective_errata.source_location: Primary PDF physical 556 / printed 541, Table 232 /MaxLen row; annotation objects 5734 (StrikeOut), 5736 (Caret).
effective_errata.effect: The value is an integer greater than or equal to zero and is the maximum length.
effective_errata.classification: Producer constraint; do not infer mandatory reader rejection of an invalid negative value.

implementation.stored_limit_helper: crates/pdf-model/src/view/fields.rs::held_to_max_len resolves the original Document's widget/field chain and reads stored /MaxLen.
implementation.scripted_limit_state: crates/pdf-model/src/view/script_model.rs::FieldState::apply sets char_limit; script_properties exposes the override; saved scripted entries write /MaxLen.
implementation.script_value_path: crates/pdf-model/src/view/scripts/edits.rs::apply_edits applies returned ScriptEdit values in sequence; a value reaches scripts/calculation.rs::write_text, which calls held_to_max_len with the original Document.
implementation.user_value_path: crates/pdf-model/src/view/fields.rs::set_field also calls held_to_max_len against the original Document after the open-script property override is live.

existing_assertions.coverage: Stored /MaxLen 10 limits a host set and the saved /V.
